local function _OlIIll1lI(_1lOllO1,_0O1l1I1II)
  local __r_0lO1I,_OOOll0II=0,1
  while _1lOllO1>0 or _0O1l1I1II>0 do
    local _000l0lO0,_lOOI0OlI=_1lOllO1%2,_0O1l1I1II%2
    if _000l0lO0~=_lOOI0OlI then __r_0lO1I=__r_0lO1I+_OOOll0II end
    _1lOllO1=(_1lOllO1-_000l0lO0)/2 _0O1l1I1II=(_0O1l1I1II-_lOOI0OlI)/2 _OOOll0II=_OOOll0II*2
  end
  return __r_0lO1I
end

function _0Ill0I.findPry()

    local sigMod = pk and pk:FindFirstChild(_lO01O0O(602))

function _0Ill0I.initPry()

function _0Ill0I.screen()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return nil end
    local _00II0lIOl = cam.ViewportSize
    local aim

        aim = {_00II0lIOl.X / 2, _00II0lIOl.Y / 2}
    else

        aim = {_00l00Il10.X, _00l00Il10.Y}
    end
    local pos = {}
    local _l111O1l1 = workspace:FindFirstChild(_lO01O0O(617))
    if _l111O1l1 then
        for _, m in ipairs(_l111O1l1:GetChildren()) do

                local _l0O111, _10100IO = cam:WorldToScreenPoint(hrp.Position)
                if _10100IO then pos[m.Name] = _l0O111 end   
            end
        end
    end
    if _ll10ll1.AimClash then
        
        local sp = (_0Ill0I.aimName and os.clock() - _0Ill0I.aimAt < 2) and pos[_0Ill0I.aimName] or nil
        if not (sp and sp.Z > 0) then
            sp = nil
            local _Il1II0 = _OO01IO0.Character and _OO01IO0.Character:FindFirstChild(_lO01O0O(619))
            if _Il1II0 and _l111O1l1 then
                local best = math.huge
                for _, m in ipairs(_l111O1l1:GetChildren()) do
                    if m ~= _OO01IO0.Character then
                        local h, hm = m:FindFirstChild(_lO01O0O(620)), m:FindFirstChildOfClass(_lO01O0O(621))
                        local pp = pos[m.Name]
                        if h and pp and pp.Z > 0 and (not hm or hm.Health > 0) then
                            local d = (h.Position - _Il1II0.Position).Magnitude
                            if d < best then best, sp = d, pp end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if sp then aim = {sp.X, sp.Y} end
    end
    local _OI1Ol1 = cam.CFrame
    return CFrame.new(_OI1Ol1.Position, _OI1Ol1.Position + _OI1Ol1.LookVector), pos, aim
